notes.title: Gun Center Simulator is OUT!
notes.content:
Hello there fellow eagle-eyed shooters!  👋

We’re happy to announce that  Gun Center Simulator is here with its full release! 🔥 
Go crazy, go loud and have fun! 😎
You can check it out right here! 👇 😍 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618200/Gun_Center_Simulator/

Also don't forget about our amazing release trailer that will prepare you for what's coming! 👇
[previewyoutube=AaWMiIvvgbA;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you for all the support during the Playtest and Demo, your feedback really helped us in the journey of releasing this game. 
Now you can have your fun in this amazing game that offers you so much! 
Organize your inventory with precision,  trade, customize and sell firearms, from classic pistols to cutting-edge weapons. 🔫 




If you wanna join fellow gun enthusiasts that want to try their best in Gun Center Simulator, make sure to visit our discord! 💬
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594234/fe8d51452bef96ab16482d2693796c0ef9338f31.png

Build your firearm empire right now 👑!
See you out there,
Gun Center Simulator Team

notes.title: Release Date Set!
notes.content:
Greetings! 👋

Ready to aim for gun business success? Because we are launching next month! 🔥

Gun Center Simulator is launching on July 21, 2025! 💥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618200/Gun_Center_Simulator/

[previewyoutube=ggfPMArzfHo;full][/previewyoutube]
Step into the shoes of a passionate collector and entrepreneur as you build, manage, and expand your very own gun center from the ground up. 🏬

Sell a vast selection of firearms - from classic pistols to the latest high-tech weaponry. Organize your inventory with care, attract a wide range of customers - hobbyists, hunters, security pros, and collectors - and watch as your gun business grows. 🔫

But the FUN part is... 👀
Not only can you sell guns - you can test them too on the SHOOTING RANGE! 🎯 The fully equipped shooting range lets you try out any firearm from your collection. Whether you’re testing a sniper rifle or a handgun, the range is the ultimate playground. 😎

So, don’t Miss the Launch! 🫵 Add Gun Center Simulator to your Steam Wishlist today and be the first to experience the excitement of running your own gun shop and shooting range! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594234/b0f1e129b77decbffcfb32a2aeccf8adef3fa211.gif

Join us on July 21, 2025, and see if you have what it takes to become the top gun dealer in town. 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45594234/fe8d51452bef96ab16482d2693796c0ef9338f31.png

Are you ready to build your gun center empire?
See you at the grand opening ✅
Gun Center Simulator Team

notes.title: Gun Range on Steam Next Fest 2025!
notes.content:
Hello there fellow shooting range enjoyers! 🎯
STEAM NEXT FEST JUNE EDITION 2025 IS HERE  and we're happy to announce that Gun Center Simulator is part of it!

During Steam Next Fest you can enjoy demoes in a more exciting way, watch livestreams, become part of the steam community.
So here is demo of our game to try out!👇
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3618220/Gun_Center_Simulator_Demo/

This is opportunity for all of us to share the feedback, understand the game better for what we need to focus on and improve it for the future.

Whatever ideas you have, whatever suggestions you want to share, share it away! Everything you say we read and user to better our products for you to try out on the full release. It is now where you can be part of the process more then ever before!🔥 

So load your magazines, oil your weapons, zero your scopes! 🔫

You can share your thoguhts ion steam discussion or even join our community on Discord and put your two bullets in about the game!
